summary:
[Project Celia] est une solution innovante développée pour relever les défis de l'agriculture durable face au changement climatique, en exploitant la puissance des données d'observation de la Terre et satellitaires. Notre application permet d'analyser en temps réel des paramètres agro-climatiques clés (tels que le stress hydrique, l'état des sols et l'évolution de la biomasse) afin d'aider les agriculteurs et les décideurs à optimiser l'irrigation, à anticiper les risques climatiques et à maximiser les rendements tout en préservant les ressources en eau.

Ce projet est d'une importance capitale pour renforcer la résilience des exploitations agricoles face aux sécheresses récurrentes et aux aléas météorologiques. En transformant des données scientifiques complexes en recommandations pratiques et accessibles, [Project Celia] démocratise l'agriculture de précision et contribue activement à la sécurité alimentaire régionale et mondiale.
details:
Project Overview & How It WorksProject Celia is an agro-climatic decision-support web application designed to help farmers and agricultural stakeholders adapt to climate variability in semi-arid regions such as the Sétif High Plains. By integrating satellite Earth observation data (such as NASA POWER agro-climatic signals) with local agricultural parameters, the platform analyzes critical indicators—including water stress, soil moisture dynamics, precipitation timing, and biomass evolution—to provide clear, actionable recommendations for irrigation scheduling and crop management.

Benefits & Expected Impact

  • Water Resource Optimization: Enables precise irrigation management, reducing water waste in drought-prone areas.
  • Risk Mitigation: Helps farmers anticipate critical climatic anomalies (such as shifted rainfall timing rather than mere seasonal averages) before crop yields are compromised.
  • Accessibility: Translates complex satellite datasets into an intuitive, user-friendly interface accessible to non-specialists, strengthening local food security and agricultural resilience.

Tools, Technologies & Data Used

  • Frontend & Web Development: Built as a modern, responsive Progressive Web App (PWA) using React, TypeScript, Vite, and HTML/CSS, managed with Bun and deployed via Git/Vercel.
  • Data Sources: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources) agro-climatic datasets and satellite remote sensing parameters tailored to regional agricultural profiles.

Creativity & Key Factors Considered What makes Project Celia unique is its focus on climatic timing and actionable simplicity. Rather than overwhelming users with raw meteorological charts, our team prioritized human-centric design, local agronomic realities (soil types, regional crop cycles, and seasonal water deficits), and offline-ready web accessibility so farmers can consult reliable insights directly in the field.
